verdict.rationale: Gide's Venture & Growth Tech practice explicitly states it supports both venture capitalists/investors and entrepreneurs across all stages from seed to exit, backed by high deal volume (70+ transactions/year, €9.2B+) and Band 1 recognition for understanding market practices, evidencing knowledge from both sides of the table. Missing for 10: independent client testimonials naming specific fund-side deals, and a granular breakdown of investor-side vs founder-side mandate volume.
